print('same set:',set(want)==set(rec))
mism=[k for k in want if k in rec and rec[k]!=want[k]]
print('hash mismatches:',len(mism), mism[:3])
" 2>&1

import zipfile,os,base64,hashlib
z=zipfile.ZipFile('ensurepip/_bundled/pip-24.3.1-py3-none-any.whl')
sp='site-packages'
n=0
for m in z.infolist():
    if m.is_dir(): continue
    tgt=os.path.join(sp,m.filename)
    os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(tgt),exist_ok=True)
    data=z.read(m)
    with open(tgt,'wb') as f: f.write(data)
    os.chmod(tgt,0o755 if m.filename.endswith(('.exe','_distutils_get_platform.py')) else 0o644)
    n+=1
print('restored entries:',n)

import os,base64,hashlib
sp='/usr/local/lib/python3.13/site-packages'
missing=[];bad=[]
for l in open(sp+'/pip-24.3.1.dist-info/RECORD'):
    p=l.rstrip('\n').split(',')
    if len(p)<3 or not p[1]: continue
    if p[0].startswith('../../../'): continue
    f=os.path.join(sp,p[0])
    if not os.path.exists(f):
        if '__pycache__' in p[0]: continue
        missing.append(p[0]); continue
    if p[1].startswith('sha256='):
        h='sha256='+base64.urlsafe_b64encode(hashlib.sha256(open(f,'rb').read()).digest()).rstrip(b'=').decode()
        if h!=p[1]: bad.append(p[0])
print('missing:',len(missing),missing[:5])
print('hash mismatches:',len(bad),bad[:5])
" 2>&1
